coordinate_mapping.note: All top/bottom files share physical XY orientation. Do not mirror image pixels. For bottom mesh use the same XY-basedUV formula and reverse normals/winding. PNG top edge is physical+Y. Three.Texture defaultflipY=true maps this correctly with u=(x+11)/22,v=(y+16)/32.

rendering_appearance.mask: #086b32 on copper; slightly darker green in copper-free regions
rendering_appearance.exposed_copper: gold/ENIG-like presentation material, not a fabrication-finish specification
rendering_appearance.silkscreen: warm white from exact native silkGerber strokes
rendering_appearance.copper_relief: subtle height/color only where nativecopper exists
rendering_appearance.hole_policy: all-drill-opacity cuts actualsubstrate holes; surface-opacity cuts only exposeddrill openings and retains native tentedmaskfilm
rendering_appearance.data_maps: metalness/roughness/opacity/relief are linear scalar 0..1, load Non-Color. Basecolor is sRGB.
